race.comment: It looks a nice race for KING INCANTO (1) to break through. He's notched up four minor placings from six runs this campaign but continues to front up and run well and this looks very winnable. BRUTIFY (6) is usually thereabouts but finds it hard to win, with only one victory from 15 starts. Was again denied last start when she found a couple better over 1100m at Casterton but comes back in grade off that and should be fitter second up, go close. MISS HIMALAYA (11) worked home well for second at Donald last time having won nicely here fresh over this route. Tough draw but look for her late. SLATE RIPPER (2) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1206m at Donald, beaten 5 lengths. Fitter so can figure in the finish.
